description: Quantified style spec for code-driven keyframe recreation, survives wipes via git

backgrounds.type: flat single color 90% minimal line art 10%

character.eyes: dot 2% head width black #000 no whites
character.hands_feet: mitten hands no fingers oval feet

props.detail: low money bag sack + $ piggy pig + slot calendar grid + numbers
props.reuse: high house for downsizer money bag for SG piggy for super

composition.position: center 60% thirds 30% alternating left/right for connected

section_structure.separator: 0.5s pause + 30ms fade to white + title card pop 0.35s ease-out-back + music subtle change

zoom_details.when: connected side-by-side ONLY when truly needed

punch_ins.when: reveals yes house SOLD, emphasis yes numbers $313k, numbers yes big number spoken, jokes no

tracking.description: No tracking 0%, camera static or slow zoom, character enters via slide

entrances.direction: left/right alternating left odd right even

part_animation.which_parts: arms wave, head tilt 5°, legs none static, tail fin none, mouth none static, eyes none no blink

faces.eyebrow_expression: new drawing replace PNG at cut not morph

on_screen_text.where_how_often: every beat 1 line max 12-16 words centered bottom or top
on_screen_text.font: handwritten marker uppercase numbers lowercase body bold

music.when: starts 00:00 continuous ducks -18.5dB vs voice -37dB music no hard stops fades out outro 10:30

voice.pauses: median 0.4s between beats dead air >0.8s removed
voice.delivery: clean no filler 12-16 words per beat

hook_first_15s.pattern: bold claim number + question + immediate visual house money bag
